$comment: Virtual skill packs — role-based bundles for one-command install. Packs are METADATA ONLY: skills stay in flat skills/<name> folders (golden rule: skills are discovered by path), a skill may belong to several packs, and every skill must belong to at least one (validate.py enforces both directions). Install a pack with `python3 pack.py <pack> --install`; see README. Rationale: docs/rfcs/0001-skill-packs.md.
